gates.name: straight_prediction
gates.threshold: MAE <= 1e-5 and p95 <= 1e-4 in every direction/speed stratum

gates.name: bouncing_prediction
gates.threshold: >= 0.20 event-balanced improvement; overall and non-bounce non-regression

gates.name: changed_law_adaptation
gates.threshold: >= 0.20 lower cumulative 50-transition error than frozen and persistence

gates.name: bounce_coverage
gates.threshold: >= 500 events across >=100 episodes and both walls

gates.name: correctness
gates.threshold: all recorded outputs finite and all requested episodes complete

gates.name: reproducibility
gates.threshold: stable role/family/replica/episode streams and versioned checkpoint state

gates.name: cpu_usability
gates.threshold: predict+update p95 <= 5 ms on the recorded CPU
